Trimester_Notes: India AMB: daily IFA from 4th month; local programme protocol applies
Reference_Regimen_or_Dose_Band: India AMB: tablet containing 60 mg elemental iron + 500 micrograms folic acid daily; minimum 180 days during pregnancy
Contraindications: Known hypersensitivity to product components
Major_Cautions: Iron overload states; significant GI intolerance; evaluate cause of anaemia
Common_Adverse_Effects: Nausea, constipation, abdominal discomfort, dark stools
Serious_Adverse_Effects: Severe hypersensitivity; iron toxicity in overdose
Pregnancy_Specific_Risks: Overdose is dangerous; unnecessary iron in non-anaemic iron-replete patients should be avoided
Monitoring: Hb; adherence; tolerance; response to treatment
Important_Interactions: Calcium, antacids and some antibiotics can reduce absorption; separate as appropriate
Renal_Considerations: Dose/formulation may need adjustment in severe renal disease
Hepatic_Considerations: No major routine hepatic adjustment; investigate unexplained anaemia
Lactation_Notes: Generally compatible; monitor infant if clinically indicated
NLEM_2022_Status: NLEM 2022: ferrous salts and folic acid listed
Source_Notes: Indian national programme source gives 60 mg elemental iron + 500 mcg folic acid tablet and timing

Pregnancy_Specific_Risks: High-dose folate should not substitute for investigation of B12 deficiency

Important_Interactions: Some antiepileptic medicines can have folate interactions
Source_Notes: High-dose folate should be encoded by indication rather than randomly assigned

Pregnancy_Specific_Risks: Excess calcium may interfere with iron absorption
Monitoring: Serum calcium/renal function when clinically indicated; adherence
Important_Interactions: Iron, levothyroxine and several antibiotics require dose separation
Hepatic_Considerations: Vitamin D/calcium disorders may require adjustment

Renal_Considerations: Evaluate cause of anaemia and liver iron overload where relevant

Pregnancy_Specific_Risks: Late-pregnancy use requires careful obstetric assessment

Source_Notes: Do not assign merely because pregnancy exists; require risk factors

Trimester_Notes: Use throughout pregnancy when clinically indicated; monitor maternal/fetal response

Important_Interactions: Other BP-lowering drugs; insulin/antidiabetic therapy may mask hypoglycaemia
Renal_Considerations: Dose/monitoring may require adjustment in renal disease
Lactation_Notes: Generally compatible; monitor infant for bradycardia/hypoglycaemia if clinically indicated
